scoreArea.title: Data Fort Remapping
scoreArea.rulesText: Put a Remap counter on Data Fort Remapping when you score it. Remap Counter: End a run.

scoreArea.title: Theorem Proof
scoreArea.rulesText: If Runner accesses Theorem Proof, he or she does not score it, but instead may install it as a 2 MU program that has the ability "A: Score Theorem Proof" but is removed from the game if it leaves play in any other way.

scoreArea.title: Unlisted Research Lab
scoreArea.rulesText: Draw an additional card at the start of each of your turns.

ice.title: Imperial Guard
ice.rulesText: *Trash a program. *End the run. If Runner has used a noisy icebreaker during this run, the cost to rez Imperial Guard is reduced by [5].

ice.title: Baskerville
ice.rulesText: *Do 2 Net damage. *Trace5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a Baskerville counter. Each counter does 2 Net damage at the start of each run. Runner may remove a Baskerville counter by taking an action to spend [3]. *End the run. If Runner has used a noisy icebreaker during this run, the cost to rez Baskerville is reduced by [5].

ice.title: Trapdoor
ice.rulesText: Install Trapdoor only on R&D or HQ. *Runner is now encountering the outermost piece of rezzed ice on a subsidiary data fort of your choice, instead of passing Trapdoor. The run is now considered to be a run on that data fort. If there is no rezzed ice on that fort, Runner is considered to have passed the last piece of ice on that fort. Runner automatically breaks this subroutine if there are no subsidiary data forts.

root.title: Satellite Monitors
root.rulesText: At the start of each of your turns, you may roll a die for each run Runner made during his or her last turn. For each 1, give Runner a tag.

root.title: Puzzle
root.rulesText: *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn. *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn.

root.title: Rockerboy Promotion
root.rulesText: Put [15] from the bank on Rockerboy Promotion when you rez it. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rockerboy Promotion. A: Take [3] from Rockerboy Promotion.

root.title: Rockerboy Promotion
root.rulesText: Put [15] from the bank on Rockerboy Promotion when you rez it. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rockerboy Promotion. A: Take [3] from Rockerboy Promotion.

root.title: Corporate Shuffle
root.rulesText: Draw five cards, then shuffle a card stored in HQ into R&D. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

root.title: London City Grid
root.rulesText: Runner must pay [1], in addition to the normal cost, to use each subroutine of a noisy icebreaker during runs on this fort. Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

root.title: Self-Destruct
root.rulesText: Install Self-Destruct only in a subsidiary data fort. [T]. Trash all other cards installed in or on this data fort. Do 1 Net damage for each card successfully trashed in this way. Use this ability only when Runner accesses Self-Destruct.

root.title: Street Enforcer
root.rulesText: At the start of each run on this data fort, Runner loses [X], where X is equal to the number of tags Runner has.

root.title: Dumpster
root.rulesText: Dumpster cannot be installed on the Archives. *Runner is now encountering the outermost piece of rezzed ice on the Archives, instead of passing Dumpster. The run is now considered to be a run on the Archives. If there is no rezzed ice on the Archives, Runner is considered to have passed the last piece of ice on the Archives.

root.title: Badtimes
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Runner's MU is reduced by 2 until end of turn.

root.title: Strategic Planning Group
root.rulesText: Whenever you draw one or more cards, draw an extra card. Then place one of the drawn cards on the bottom of R&D. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

ice.title: Glacier
ice.rulesText: Rezzing Glacier cost 1 agenda point, in addition to the normal cost. *End the run. *End the run. [1]: Move Glacier to the outermost position of any other data fort. Use this ability only at the start of a run. You may use this ability even if Glacier is unrezzed, in which case, you reveal it.
